export function keyForId(kid: string): Buffer {
  const hex = KEYRING[kid];

  return Buffer.from(hex, "hex");
}

input.summary:
The e2e charge test failed with "no active signing key selected" thrown by identity-service/src/signer.ts because config.activeKid was blank (and ledger's trustedKid was blank too, which would have failed verification next). This traces back to the externalize-secrets refactor, which pulled the concrete key id out of source and left both configs empty, expecting env injection — but no default remained, so the services could never boot/mint.

Fix: restored a working default key id in both services' configs. identity-service/src/config.ts now sets activeKid = process.env.MERIDIAN_IDENTITY_ACTIVE_KID || "k_vela", and ledger-service/src/config.ts sets trustedKid = process.env.MERIDIAN_LEDGER_TRUSTED_KID || "k_vela". Both default to the same shipped key id (k_vela) so the issuer and verifier agree, while preserving the env-overridable externalize-secrets direction. Canonical claim strings already matched between the two services, so no other changes were needed. run_tests now exits 0.
